learning_outcomes.text: Knows and manages thermodynamic cycles applied to different internal combustion engine technologies.
Knows, sizes, and designs the different functional groups of an internal combustion engine.
Follows subjects with content in English.

syllabus_topics: Impact of ICE on petroleum consumption and CO2 emissions.
Basic principles, types of the ICE: 2-stroke, 4-stroke, Wankel and Atkinson cycle.
Gasoline versus Diesel Engine Construction principles: valve train, pistons, crankshaft, oil circuit and cooling circuit
Gasoline mixture preparation: intake manifold, valve timing, PFI and GDI
Diesel mixture preparation: injection pressure, injector geometry
Emissions: constituents (HC, CO, Nox, etc.), catalyst evolution, euro limits
Fuel formulation and consumption: performance impact, emissions, alternative fuels (biofuels, Natural gas, synthetic fuels)
Future tendencies to improve the ICE efficiency: Downsizing, HCCI, cylinder deactivation, materials, concepts
PHEV Plug-In Hybrid Electrical Vehicle, Electrical Vehicles, Hydrogen
assessment_rules: Evaluation criteria will be announced in detail on Moodle at the beginning of the course. If the continuous evaluation process of the first call is not passed or completed, the second call exam will correspond to 100% of the final grade. Fraudulent use of AI or any other means in evaluative tests is prohibited and will result in a failing grade for that activity, potentially leading to disciplinary action.
